### transit-gateway-appliance-mode-flow-hash-symmetric

**Claim.** With appliance mode, a transit gateway uses a flow hash algorithm to pick one network interface in the appliance VPC for the life of the flow and uses the same interface for return traffic, so bidirectional traffic is routed symmetrically through the same Availability Zone.

**Write it as.** `flow hash algorithm` · `routed symmetrically`

**Scope.** transit gateway appliance mode.

> "When appliance mode is enabled, a transit gateway selects a single network interface in the appliance VPC, using a flow hash algorithm, to send traffic to for the life of the flow. The transit gateway uses the same network interface for the return traffic. This ensures that bidirectional traffic is routed symmetrically—it's routed through the same Availability Zone in the VPC attachment for the life of the flow."
> — [How AWS Transit Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/how-transit-gateways-work.html)
